added: Printed and shared dance cards can now show a dance's hook and its published sources (title, author, year, page and number). Both are off by default; turn them on under Settings › Defaults › Shared dance fields.
changed: In set lists, a formation you have given your own colour now keeps that colour on the row, instead of the built-in tint for its formation family. Formations you have not coloured keep the family tint, and mixers always keep the mixer accent.

added: `DanceShareField.hook` and `DanceShareField.sources`, with `DanceCardContent.hook` / `sourceLines`, `danceCardSourceLines` and the `sourceLines` parameter of `danceToPlainText`. Both fields are excluded from `DanceShareField.allExceptTunes`.
